descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P0 · stated in the UAT / ticket AC · UAT TC-10 ER 6; TFA-92588 AC 8; TFA-94745 state 3 · “If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled”. Mixed: stated part — R1 summary failure (text kept, error, Generate disabled), R2 yesterday's one-liner never shown as today's, R4; our part — R3 extractTasks failing during Save Note and recovering without duplicates (only the stated part makes a QA bug).

Bug B05 · S0 · known

After a failed summary retry, today's note contains yesterday-only values; a partial summary still says '✓ Note saved' and yesterday's one-liner and chest X-ray stay on the panel without notice

Tickets: TFA-92592 ready for qa; TFA-92588 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: no (fix in PR #100/#101) · found on: dev + local

Note: Re-test 2026-10-15 on 43c38a4f: the Hospital note half is fixed on dev (TC-10/S12); still there: the Nursing Home summary and note present yesterday's values as current (no backgroundContext: yesterday's 38.2 °C as 'low-grade fever', K 5.9 as current), and a partial summary still shows plain success with yesterday's one-liner and chest X-ray (TC-10/S26 R2). Counted again because both tickets are ready for QA now.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-10/S12

Approach · TC-10 Pre-Rounding Summary · S26 Save Note outcome by which AI call fails, both modes: summary fails, summary returns without its background and studies, task extraction fails, nothing fails

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 If the summary call fails: the raw dictation is kept, an explicit error shows, and Generate is disabled until a Save succeeds (PR #53). Yesterday's panels are never silently reused. (UAT TC-10; TFA-92588 AC 8; TFA-94745 state 3; UAT Empty & Failure States)
  • T4 The summary-failed state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's style (never a blank screen, crash, raw error pop-up or invented content), loses nothing typed or dictated, appears only af … (TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 2; TFA-94745 AC 3; TFA-94745 AC 4; TFA-94745 AC 5; UAT Empty & Failure States; UAT 3.5)
  • U10 Every step works, and must pass, in both Hospital and Nursing Home. (UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given A fresh @roundai.test account on the local stack; a Hospital patient and a Nursing Home resident each seeded with yesterday's Background / Admission Summary one-liner and one study (for row R2); …

When Per mode: R1 ai/parsing:parsePreRoundNotes failFirst → type, Save Note, open Encounter, then Save Note again with no failure; R2 parsePreRoundNotes mockResponses returns a success payload with background '' and radiology [] → Save Note; …

Then R1: 'Note saved, but the structured summary couldn’t be updated … tap Save Note to retry' is visible, the textarea still holds the typed text, and on the Encounter tab Generate Note & Finish is disabled with the 'did not finish processing' reason; after the clean second Save no error and Generate enabled. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions. R1 and R4 are asserted from U6/T4 in both modes (the Nursing Home catch in useSnfPreRoundProcess.ts that #89 added runs only here: S12 seeds its error and S11 is Hospital only). R2 is asserted on the literal U6 ('never silently reused'): Fail if yesterday's one-liner or study is shown with only '✓ … Auto-updated' and no notice naming them; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method FAULT · Fault injection; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S26 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-10.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Known product issue · environment local · tickets TFA-92588 ready for qa; TFA-94745 ready for qa

When the summary comes back without background and studies, the physician sees '✓ Note saved. Auto-updated…' (Nursing Home shows just 'Saved 3:16 PM'). Yesterday's one-liner and chest X-ray stay on the panels, and nothing says they were not refreshed.

Evidence: allure c07b5c10: R2 fails in both modes. R1 (summary fails) and R4 pass, and R3 (task extraction fails) is recorded under Q15. TC-10 Q14 and TC-10 risks already describe this: parsePreRoundNotes uses Promise.allSettled and only the main extraction throws. It fails under either answer to Q14 (an error with Generate disabled, or a notice naming the stale panels). Daniela picks which one.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20 re-run), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: FAULT · Fault injection; secondary: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.
